decisive_items: a well-defined, heterogeneous, pre-pyloric mass measuring 6×5 cm with fat attenuation in the antropyloric region
response.rationale: The presence of fat attenuation on CT is pathognomonic for a lipoma. The other options (peptic ulcer, carcinoid, GIST) do not typically exhibit fat attenuation. The location in the gastric antrum makes gastric lipoma the most specific diagnosis.
